title: Positioning: the knowledge graph IS the moat (speed + autonomy + self-learning are what it buys)
summary: Code-verified vs Claude Code v2.1.160. SINGLE moat = the token-economic task knowledge graph; everything else is a consequence, not a separate pillar. (1) TOKEN-SAVE: typed context edges + two-tier summary handoff — absent in native (blockedBy-only) and all competitors. (2) CHEAP MERGEABLE PARALLELISM->speed: the graph lets agents fan out wide WITHOUT per-agent context blowup and merge results via edges; raw parallelism is commoditized (Cursor/Factory/Copilot/native dynamic workflows), the graph is what makes it affordable AND mergeable. (3) Long-running SELF-* loop (research/improve/test) = the killer app the substrate uniquely enables; it depends on durable execution, our WEAKEST layer -> borrow/wrap Temporal-style durability, do not build. (4) SELF-LEARNING: the same graph compounds knowledge across runs (note nodes, decisions, learned judge patterns) so the system improves with use — the temporal dimension that WIDENS the moat with usage. Pitch the GRAPH, not the four features. Existential risk: Anthropic adds cross-workspace + resume to Agent Teams.
